idea-plugin.name: Phantom Icon Pack
idea-plugin.description: Colored file and folder icons by name and extension, drawn from the Material Icon Theme by Philipp Kief (MIT). Java and Kotlin classes show Material icons by kind, told apart by shape: class, abstract class, interface, enum, annotation, record or data class, exception, object; Kotlin's carry the Kotlin mark. A Java file, and a Kotlin file of one class, shows its class's kind also as a file (Project view, navigation bar, editor tabs); other Kotlin files show the Kotlin logo, a Java file without a class the Java cup. Source, test and resource roots get their own folder colors. Only the icons of files on screen are loaded. Turn the plugin off to get the platform icons back.
